prompt: I am thinking of a movie where Hans Zimmer won a Grammy Award for his work. He won the Grammy award the same year that he did his first musical score for film director Michael Bay. Can you please tell me the name of that movie?
answer: The movie was **_The Rock_ (1996)**. It was Hans Zimmer’s first film score collaboration with director Michael Bay, alongside Nick Glennie-Smith and Harry Gregson-Williams. That same year, Zimmer won a Grammy for **“Crimson Tide”** in the category of Best Instrumental Composition Written for a Motion Picture or for Television.
